course.title: System Development Project
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A small post office has two open windows. Customers arrive according to a Poisson distribution at the rate of 1 every 3 minutes. However, only 80% of them seek service at the windows. The service time per customer is exponential, with a mean of 5 minutes. All arriving customers from one line and access available windows on an FCFS basis. Answer the followings:
i) Would it be possible to offer reasonable service with only one window? Explain
ii) Probability of waiting more than 3 minutes in queue.
